# Fixed seeds for reproducibility. The harness derives every per-trial RNG seed
# deterministically from masterSeed via core.TrialSeed(masterSeed, scenario,
# defender, trial) = FNV-1a(masterSeed || scenario || defender || trial). The SAME
# masterSeed reproduces the entire run.
#
# Smoke run masterSeed:
1337
#
# Full-benchmark masterSeed (>=20 trials/arm), kept distinct for a fresh draw:
20240601
